info.name: Adyen Get a List of Terminals

params.name: searchQuery
params.description: Returns terminals with an ID that contains the specified string. If present, other query parameters are ignored.

params.name: otpQuery
params.description: Returns one or more terminals associated with the one-time passwords specified in the request. If this query parameter is used, other query parameters are ignored.

params.name: countries
params.description: Returns terminals located in the countries specified by their [two-letter country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2).

params.name: merchantIds
params.description: Returns terminals that belong to the merchant accounts specified by their unique merchant account ID.

params.name: storeIds
params.description: Returns terminals that are assigned to the [stores](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/ManagementService/latest/get/stores) specified by their unique store ID.

params.name: brandModels
params.description: Returns terminals of the [models](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/#/ManagementService/latest/get/companies/{companyId}/terminalModels) specified in the format *brand.model*.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The number of the page to fetch.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items to have on a page, maximum 100. The default is 20 items on a page.

items.docs:
Returns the payment terminals that the API credential has access to and that match the query parameters. 
To make this request, your API credential must have the following [roles](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/api-credentials#api-permissions):
* Management API — Terminal actions read

Schedules a [terminal action](https://docs.adyen.com/point-of-sale/automating-terminal-management/terminal-actions-api) by specifying the action and the terminals that the action must be applied to. 

The following restrictions apply:
* You can schedule only one action at a time. For example, to install a new app version and remove an old app version, you have to make two API requests.

To make this request, your API credential must have the following [role](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/api-credentials#api-permissions):

items.docs:
Returns the logo that is configured for the payment terminal identified in the path.
The logo is returned as a Base64-encoded string. You need to Base64-decode the string to get the actual image file.

To make this request, your API credential must have one of the following [roles](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/api-credentials#api-permissions):
* Management API—Terminal settings read
* Management API—Terminal settings read and write

params.name: terminalId
params.description: The unique identifier of the payment terminal.

items.docs:
Updates the logo for the payment terminal identified in the path.

* To change the logo, specify the image file as a Base64-encoded string.
* To restore the logo inherited from a higher level (store, merchant account, or company account), specify an empty logo value.

To make this request, your API credential must have the following [role](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/api-credentials#api-permissions):
* Management API—Terminal settings read and write

params.name: terminalId
params.description: The unique identifier of the payment terminal.

items.docs:

* Management API—Terminal settings read
* Management API—Terminal settings read and write

items.docs:
Updates the settings that are configured for the payment terminal identified in the path.

* To change a parameter value, include the full object that contains the parameter, even if you don't want to change all parameters in the object.
* To restore a parameter value inherited from a higher level, include the full object that contains the parameter, and specify an empty value for the parameter or omit the parameter.
* Objects that are not included in the request are not updated.
